label: Flag Record
description: The flag-for-YAC UI write surface (DESIGN.md §5.8). v3 redesign (CASE-481): identity is the composite natural key [flag_type, flagged_document] — 'Ready-for-discussion on CASE-478' is unique, and re-flagging the same type on the same doc is an idempotent version, not a duplicate. flag_type is the intent; flagged_document is the doc being flagged (the FLAGGED_FROM edge derives from it). doc_status defaults to 'published' (flags are dispatched events; the create path must set it — the v2 'doc_status required' failure is fixed by the gateway flag verb supplying it). Three axes (CASE-1291): flag_type is the kind of work, and kind carries the same value as a CLAIM_KIND term so it is validated (flag_type is an identity string, whose type cannot change; the proxy guard sets kind from it); target_yac is the owner, whose code it is; worker optionally names the AGENT_IDENTITY that should do it — without one, the dispatcher picks an active worker that performs the kind for the owner.
